glosses: Providing physical comfort and ease; agreeable.

examples.text: This is the most comfortable bed I’ve ever slept in.
We toted in the wood and got the fire going nice and comfortable. Lord James still set in one of the chairs and Applegate had cabbaged the other and was hugging the stove.

glosses: In a state of comfort and content.

examples.text: What a great guestroom! I'll be quite comfortable here.

A great bargain also had been[…]the arm-chair in which Bunting now sat forward, staring into the dull, small fire. In fact, that arm-chair had been an extravagance of Mrs. Bunting. She had wanted her husband to be comfortable after the day's work was done, and she had paid thirty-seven shillings for the chair.

glosses: Confident; relaxed; not worried about someone or something.

examples.text: A comfortable income should suffice to consider oneself rich.
The home team is ahead by a comfortable margin.

When Hape sauntered over for a try after only three minutes it looked as if England were destined for a comfortable victory, but Georgia are made of sterner stuff, as they showed when running Scotland close in Invercargill last week.

examples.text: Être commode à vivre.
Avoir l’humeur, un caractère commode.

glosses: Qui est trop indulgent, trop facile. Ainsi on dit d’un mari qui ferme les yeux sur la mauvaise conduite de sa femme et d’une femme qui donne trop de liberté à sa fille.

examples.text: C’est un mari commode

glosses: Se dit aussi, familièrement et ironiquement, pour signifier qu’on ne met pas assez de façons aux choses, qu’on cherche plus ce qui est aisé que ce qui est convenable.

examples.text: Il aurait aimé pouvoir se réfugier derrière de fallacieux prétextes, bien commodes.

glosses: Nom donné à certain type d'armoire.

examples.text: Je vais monter une armoire : c’est une commode.

glosses: Meuble à hauteur d’appui, garni de tiroirs et servant particulièrement à ranger du linge et des habits.

examples.text: Où, avec génie, du reste, avez-vous caché le bouquetier de faïence qui sera pour votre chambre ? Je le cherche depuis quelques heures, dans la commode, le petit placard, l'office, en vain : et le plateau à thé ?
